about: Ask on first use (the sandbox-default lane, 2026-09-27), the same in both chats. When a confined command's proxy refused a host (read from srt's own log, sandbox/srt.json `refused_hosts`), the interactive chat asks the owner by name with `question`; `once` re-runs the command with the host for that run, `always` writes it into the agent file's `sandbox: network: hosts:` by a line edit (`cases`) and re-runs, anything else returns the output with the hint. Never asked in `serve`, the daemon, `-p` or for a caller other than the owner. Python: webagents/cli/sandbox_default_hosts.py, tests/cli/test_sandbox_default_hosts.py. TypeScript: src/cli/sandbox-default-hosts.ts, tests/unit/cli/sandbox-default-hosts.test.ts.

words.hostQuestion: Allow it? [o]nce, [a]lways (adds it to the agent file), [N]o:
words.hostNotWritten: Could not add {host} to {file}: {problem}. Add it under `sandbox: network: hosts:` by hand.
words.hostNoFile: the built-in agent has no file

cases.case: no sandbox block: one is added before the closing fence
cases.after:
---
name: a
skills:
  - shell
sandbox:
  network:
    hosts:
      - example.com
---
Body.

cases.case: sandbox with a hosts block list: appended after the last entry
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  network:
    hosts:
      - github.com
    local: true
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  network:
    hosts:
      - github.com
      - example.com
    local: true
---
Body.

cases.case: the old bare network list: appended there
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  network:
    - github.com
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  network:
    - github.com
    - example.com
---
Body.

cases.case: an empty hosts list: one entry as a block
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  network:
    hosts: []
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  network:
    hosts:
      - example.com
---
Body.

cases.case: an empty bare network list: one entry as a block
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: strict
  network: []
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: strict
  network:
    - example.com
---
Body.

cases.case: sandbox without network: a network block is added at the end of the sandbox block
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  # comment
  env:
    - GH_TOKEN
model: openai/gpt-4o-mini
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  preset: development
  # comment
  env:
    - GH_TOKEN
  network:
    hosts:
      - example.com
model: openai/gpt-4o-mini
---
Body.

cases.case: a network mapping without hosts: hosts is added to it
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  network:
    local: true
---
Body.
cases.after:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  network:
    local: true
    hosts:
      - example.com
---
Body.

cases.case: a flow list with entries is left alone
cases.before:
---
name: a
sandbox:
  network:
    hosts: [github.com]
---
Body.
cases.problem: `hosts: [github.com]` is not a block list that can take a host
`sandbox: off` is not a block that can take a host
the file has no front matter
